## Summary

This PR adds unit tests for the Calculator utility class.

## Changes

- Add test file for Calculator class
- Test basic arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide)
- Test error handling for division by zero
- Test async operations
- Test history tracking feature
- Test reset functionality

## Testing

Run tests with:
```bash
npm test -- --testPathPattern=calculator
```
